lines.text: Broken tile looks like rubble. So how does it become something people buy?
lines.phonemes: bɹˈoʊkən tˈaɪl lˈʊks lˈaɪk ɹˈʌbəl. sˌoʊ hˌaʊ dˈʌz ɪt bɪkˌʌm sˈʌmθɪŋ pˈiːpəl bˈaɪ?

lines.text: Chandigarh's Rock Garden is studded with broken crockery and tile.
lines.phonemes: tʃˌʌndiːɡˈɑːɹz ɹˈɑːk ɡˈɑːɹdən ɪz stˈʌdᵻd wɪð bɹˈoʊkən kɹˈɑːkɚɹi ænd tˈaɪl.

lines.text: Sort the shards by colour, glue them on a base, and grout the gaps.
lines.tts: Sort the shards by color, glue them on a base, and grout the gaps.
lines.phonemes: sˈɔːɹt ðə ʃˈɑːɹdz baɪ kˈʌlɚ, ɡlˈuː ðˌɛm ˌɔn ɐ bˈeɪs, ænd ɡɹˈaʊt ðə ɡˈæps.

lines.text: Seal it, add felt, and it's a coaster set or a small tabletop.
lines.phonemes: sˈiːl ɪt, ˈæd fˈɛlt, ænd ɪts ɐ kˈoʊstɚ sˈɛt ɔːɹ ɐ smˈɔːl tˈeɪbəltˌɑːp.

lines.text: Its price must cover materials, your labour and selling costs; the rest is profit.
lines.tts: Its price must cover materials, your labor and selling costs; the rest is profit.
lines.phonemes: ɪts pɹˈaɪs mˈʌst kˈʌvɚ mətˈɪɹiəlz, jʊɹ lˈeɪbɚ ænd sˈɛlɪŋ kˈɔsts; ðə ɹˈɛst ɪz pɹˈɑːfɪt.

lines.text: So price one set before you make ten.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ pɹˈaɪs wˈʌn sˈɛt bᵻfˌɔːɹ juː mˌeɪk tˈɛn.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
